summary: EQT Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity securities and its monthly transactional net asset value per share. The company sold 6,381,666 shares across multiple classes for aggregate cash consideration of approximately $171.8 million at prices ranging from $25.36 to $27.63 per share, based on May 31, 2026 NAV. Sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S. This is a routine periodic offering update, not a special situation. No terms beyond those stated; no event driven catalyst to monitor.
